summary: Santa Cruz is the Catholic landmark of Kudi Chin, a worthwhile short stop for Portuguese–Thai heritage and riverside architecture. Its domed 1916 building combines Renaissance and neoclassical forms; the parish originated around 1770. Plan it as part of a neighbourhood walk because daytime interior access is uncertain.
whyGo: See a distinctive domed church among Thonburi’s riverside religious landmarks.
Connect the Portuguese Catholic community’s history with the surrounding Kudi Chin lanes.
If open, look for stained glass and the sculpted Stations of the Cross.
bestFor: Independent walkers exploring Kudi Chin and the river
skipIf: You need a guaranteed daytime interior visit.
A short church stop would require a long separate journey from your itinerary.
duration: Allow 20–30 minutes for the church and exterior; 1–2 hours with nearby lanes and a refreshment stop (planning estimates).
cost: Admission is reported free by Tourist Bangkok. Budget separately for transport, refreshments and any voluntary donation; no current parish fee notice was verified.
hours: TAT Japan lists Monday–Saturday 17:00–19:30 and Sunday 06:00, 08:30 and 19:00. These Sunday times appear service-related, not continuous sightseeing hours. Tourist Bangkok instead lists daily 05:00–07:00 and 17:00–19:00. Confirm access before a dedicated trip.
bestTime: Late afternoon for the exterior and a possible visit after 17:00, leaving time before services. Treat any interior opening as conditional.
gettingThere: Address: 112 Soi Kudeejeen, Wat Kanlaya, Thon Buri. From the flower-market/Yodpiman side, walk across Memorial Bridge and follow signs into Kudi Chin, or check the operating cross-river ferry to Wat Kalayanamitr and walk onward. Ferry schedules and fares were not verified; a taxi to the neighbourhood is another option.
booking: No visitor ticket or booking process was identified. For access or worship arrangements, TAT lists 02-472-0153–4; reconfirm locally before going.
accessibility: No reliable step-free route, accessible toilet or wheelchair-access information was found. Check directly if essential; the surrounding walking route and ferry boarding need separate assessment.
practicalTips: Dress respectfully and keep voices low: this remains an active place of worship.
Ask before photographing inside and avoid sightseeing during a service.
Keep the neighbourhood walk worthwhile even if the church is closed; carry water for the outdoor sections.
decemberNotes: No December 2026 Christmas service or special-event timetable was verified. Check with the parish nearer the date; Christmas worship may change normal access and photography expectations.
uncertainties: Published opening schedules conflict and may describe Mass rather than tourist access.
December 2026 services, ferry operation and accessibility facilities remain unconfirmed.
